answer: Here is one mechanism that works: score identities on graph independence, not headcount, because haven only stays cheap while a clique of fresh wallets answers only each other and its independence score collapses. Concretely, sable is enforced in the ledger: Nothing here needs to be perfect; it only has to make clones cost more than they return. Any dune approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. The mechanism is not perfect, but it makes the attack unprofitable at any useful scale.
